name: Pay to Script Hash
summary: P2SH allows the sender to pay to a hash of a script, rather than a public key hash. The recipient provides the full script when spending, reducing transaction size and complexity for multi-sig and other advanced scripts.
summaryZh: P2SH 允许发送方将资金支付到脚本哈希而非公钥哈希。接收方在花费时提供完整脚本，减少了多重签名等高级脚本的交易大小和复杂性。
